evidence.quoted_text: matches = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith('ExecStart=')]
evidence.reason: Line 465 recognizes only the exact `ExecStart=` spelling. systemd unit syntax ignores whitespace around `=`, so `ExecStart = ...` is an effective directive too. A template containing both the exact and spaced forms passes the `len(matches) != 1` check, the Node renderer replaces only the exact line, and the spaced directive remains effective. A template with only the spaced form is rejected even though it is valid. This is an ordinary parser correctness defect; the current contract does not retire or supersede it.
